selection: The previous noisy ring failure and its exact population obstruction motivate lag 1/2. The model-assisted choice is fixed before all fresh data below; no performance tuning on this new bank.
baseline: Actual frozen joint_analog.certify_means API with the stronger direct physical bridge; both earlier fixed parameters retained. Fresh independent record banks under the same model, not reused held-out data or a weaker statistical baseline.
resource_scope: Evolution time is matched; readout/preparation counts are explicitly different. Preparation, resets, sensor operations, computing time and energy are unmeasured and not assigned zero. No calibrated joule saving or total-wall-time equality is asserted.
detector: Same rounded cosine as the prior benchmark; noisy version is half cosine plus independent fair noise of amplitude one half. Endpoint noises independent, sensor memory absent, acquisitions independently stationary.
physical_bridge: At s=0, the direct semigroup defect at lag t=tau/2 is -C(tau). Its other coefficients vanish, so neither a zero-lag calibration nor a t-lag record is required. The pair-score Hoeffding gap is [.5-Wmean-sqrt(log(1/alpha)/(2n))]+ and is supplied to from_gap at lag tau/2.
reporting: Report every case and both fixed baseline parameters; no unadjusted maximum of tests. Save exact sufficient statistics for all datasets and first raw bank per case. Retain negative controls and non-detections.
